Mont-Tremblant (Canada) — circuit survey

Canadian GP 1968/1970 (classic, retired) · theme green · clockwise · built on 925c3eb (branch cursor/mont_tremblant-survey-a1, with shot tooling + day-wet lighting PR #1979 merged) · captured 2026-10-15 · TLX on SwiftShader, 1280×720 · read-only survey, no source edited.

Code and geometry

Built length (centreline total)4208.5 m — measured, 1052 nodes. Def `lengthKm` 4.243, `path.len` 4243 (source metadata), researched 4265. Built is −0.8 % vs 4243 and −1.3 % vs 4265.
Winding / lapsClockwise (`reverse:false`), 3 laps default. `startFrac` 0.6465 (index frac), `sceneryStartFrac` 0, so scenery has a residual shift (brief §7: ≈0.28).
WidthConstant half-width 7 m (14 m road), no `hwZones`. Measured min 7, max 7.
ElevationMeasured Y −5.6 … +22.6 m (relief 28.2 m), max grade 6.2 %. Def has no authored `elevations`/`undulate`; profile comes from the surveyed-elevation override. Highest point near frac 0.90 (Y 22.6), lowest near 0.45 (−5.6). Brief calls elevation "severe"; 28 m relief and ≤6 % grade is moderate.
BankingNone: `banked:false`, max bank 0 rad (measured).
Min node radius9.01 m at node 944 (verify-track). Tightest listed corner R≈16 m at frac 0.8986.
Theme / palette`theme:green`, `night:false`, fir trees, `lamp:"none"`, armco/mesh fence/tyre stack kit. Grass [0.18,0.38,0.18], fogDensity 0.0030, cool-grey horizon.
Terrain`terrainOuter` 110, `flatTerrain` false, no bridges/bankZones/pit/own pit straight in the def.
Landmarks (required modelGroups)tremblant-control-tower, tremblant-hump-crest, tremblant-bridge, tremblant-namerow-bank, tremblant-paddock-bend-stand (tests/data/landmarks/mont_tremblant.json). Plus waterBand `tremblant-lac-ouimet` (not a modelGroup).
Scenery call counts (source, textual)pine 14, tree 7, bush 5, guardrail 10, marshalPost 11, addBox 20, billboard 5, building 4, grandstandEx 2, spectatorHill 2, tyreWall 4, fence 4, cameraTower 3, motorhome 3, groundPatch 4, ridge 2, mountain 4 (+ridgeAt/massifAt helpers), waterBand 1, modelGroup 5, forestEdge 0.
Prop geometryverify-track: 149,191 prop verts + 8,163 instanced; road 24,496; terrain 25,248; 14 trees suppressed by the guard.

Assets, lights, tables

  • Materials used: MAT.CONCRETE, MAT.METAL, MAT.FOLIAGE, MAT.GLASS (scenery :523-528, :726); everything else is procedural colour. Baked PBR pack applies engine-wide.
  • Night lamps: none authored (furniture.lamp:"none", night:false, no lamp emitter in the scenery file) — hence the dark unlit night frames; only the pit-straight lamp posts in frames carry light.
  • Terrain/width/elevation/banking tables: def has none of bridges, bankZones, hwZones, elevations, undulate, pit; terrainOuter 110; elevation is the surveyed override (relief 28.2 m). graph-parity is not applicable (no migration pending; the tool refuses BASE=HEAD against an unchanged tree).
  • Landmark registry: 5 required modelGroup ids (tests/data/landmarks/mont_tremblant.json). The Bridge deck is plain addBox, so it is not a landmark and no footprint guard covers it.

Rendered defect → code cause

  • Slab garage/hill (#01, #07, #08): scenery :487 single 118 m building; hills are ridge/mountain flat-coloured meshes (:433-459).
  • Empty verge (#02, #05, #50…): forest wall starts at CAM_NEAR 22 m (:53) and rank spacing every(14); orbit/eye corridor blocks infield props (:85-87).
  • Namerow dressing on the wrong bend (#69, #70): rows are authored on frac 0.836 (:817-819) which is a falling R80 bend; the uphill R16 hairpin sits at authored 0.615 and is bare.
  • Bridge deck not visible (#68, captured at engine 0.0589 = authored 0.776): abutments render, but the 34×8 m deck addBox at +7.2 m (:769-772) does not appear over the road. Likely dropped by the engine over-road guard (see the file header :99-103) or hidden by the orbit camera; not confirmed.
  • Unfinished boxes near racing 0.5 (#04): that racing frac is authored ≈0.217, the esses exit, where groundPatch/addBox gravel spill is authored (:595-612).

Real-world sources (from the brief, not re-fetched here): Wikipedia, RacingCircuits.info, Speedtherapy track notes, CMHF Namerow. Real corner order/elevation is a claim from those pages.

Not captured / uncertain

  • Only orbit (plus dry-day eye) cams; no trackside or aerial grid. Lap-position fracs 0, .17, .33, .5, .67, .83 are RACING-frame (captions give the authored-frame equivalent); landmarks seen only via 4 extra dry-day orbit frames.
  • Weather × time-of-day: day × {dry, wet, rain, overcast, fog, storm}, plus dusk/night × {dry, rain}. Not captured: dawn, dusk/night × wet/fog/storm/overcast.
  • Contact sheets of dry, eye, storm, rain, overcast, fog, night and dusk-rain were reviewed; wet and dusk-dry were not individually inspected.
  • Defect #1: the row-to-corner mapping is measured (TrackSpace.sceneryNode + curvature); that the real Namerow is the uphill hairpin comes from the brief's cited sources (RacingCircuits.info, Speedtherapy notes), which I did not re-fetch.
  • Moving frames, car-on-track z-fighting/shimmer and the engine's behaviour at the Hump (airborne) were not exercised. Real-circuit facts (Hump height, corner names) are brief/source claims, unverified here.
  • Orbit cam avoids infield props by design, so enclosure on the +1 side is under-represented in orbit frames.
  • The gallery parser's WEATHER_TAIL does not list storm, so storm frames may file with tod "unknown" in the gallery (see build result in the hand-off).
